theorem.name: Herm2ThreeRowUnderdeterminationTheorem
theorem.statement: On the source-orthonormal B_Huv domain, the trace-free Higgs mass/strain object is M(a,b,c)=[[a,b+i c],[b-i c,-a]].  Nondegeneracy excludes only (a,b,c)=0, while phase covariance rotates the (b,c) plane and leaves a^2+b^2+c^2 and a^2/(a^2+b^2+c^2) as invariant diagnostics.  Therefore the current closed data select the domain and accepted form, but not the vector (a,b,c).  A selected Hessian/value functional, full M_source+R_H restriction, or C5-C6 projection bridge is required before Delta/Re(Omega)/Im(Omega) can be emitted.

this_is_not_a_global_MTT_nogo: It only blocks promotion from the current closed support packets; a later selected Hessian, response functional, or C5-C6 bridge can still close the row.
